events.verdict: George (OKC) jumps A to B and makes body contact with Walker (CHA) that affects his shot attempt at the basket.
George (OKC) sets the pick on Lamb (CHA) after the dribble hand-off and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Zeller (CHA) makes contact with the ball and any contact with Westbrook (OKC) is incidental.
Adams (OKC) makes a natural move to the basket after the initial contact during the pick. Any contact thereafter is deemed incidental.

Adams (OKC) firms up in a screening position in Lamb's (CHA) path and absorbs the contact during the inbound. As he is firming up, his right arm extends slightly from the frame of his body, but he keeps it collapsed and does not deliver any contact.
Batum (CHA) and George (OKC) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of Thunder possession is confirmed.
Schroder (OKC) briefly places his arm around Batum (CHA) as the pick is set, but slides it off without affecting his FOM.
Adams (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position and gives Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) room to avoid the contact.
Abrines (OKC) places his hand on Batum's (CHA) opposite side hip as he goes to set the screen, but corrects himself without affecting Batum's FOM.
Batum (CHA) firms up in a screening position in Schroder's (OKC) path and absorbs contact.
Batum (CHA) sets the pick on Schroder (OKC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Adams (OKC) firms up in a screening position in Kidd-Gilchrist's (CHA) path and absorbs the contact.
Zeller (CHA) makes marginal contact with Westbrook (OKC) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Westbrook (OKC) does not extend his off-arm into Zeller's (CHA) body and dislodge him from his legal guarding position
Westbrook (OKC) places a legal forearm against Walker (CHA) at the start of his drive and does not affect his SQBR.
Zeller (CHA) commits a take foul on Schroder (OKC).
Zeller (CHA) enters the lane before the release of Schroder's (OKC) free throw.
Westbrook (OKC) briefly puts his hand to Walker's (CHA) front during the dribble, but the contact is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
Batum (CHA) commits a take foul on George (OKC).
George (OKC) does not beat Walker (CHA) to the spot and is not in a legal guarding position at the time of the contact.
